overall_assessment: Anonymization works well for HVL. None of the 28 packet courses keeps a person's name, e-mail, phone number or administrative date stamp, and none lost course content: reference editors ('Eilifsen, Margareth (red.)'), 'Kunnskapsløftet 2020', 'fagfornyinga (2020)', 'One Ocean 2021' and LK20 all stay. All 20 name_like flags are false alarms on organisation or programme names (Ole Bull Akademiet, Community Music, Grieg Research School, One Ocean, Erasmus BIP/COIL), and a scan of all 1,671 published HVL plans finds only such pairs, no campus-contact name lines and no role label followed by a name, so the leaks from the previous audit are fixed (#301, #306). The one remaining defect is the Nynorsk 'not offered' notice, which .anon_hvl() does not match. 'gjelder fra og med kull 2025' (20 plans) was judged a cohort transition rule, i.e. content, not an admin stamp.

findings.evidence: Emnet vert ikkje tilbydd [−2025/2026.−] . MGBMU241 Musikk 1, emne 2
findings.description: .anon_hvl() removes the whole Bokmål offering notice 'Emnet tilbys ikke studieåret 2025/2026.', because without the year it would read 'not offered' (#306). All three Bokmål notices in the packet are removed correctly (hvl_LUPEM102-1_2024_spring_1, hvl_LUPEM102-1_2025_spring_1, hvl_LUPEM302-1_2025_spring_1). The Nynorsk form 'Emnet vert ikkje tilbydd [studieåret] 2025/2026.' is not matched, so the generic academic-year rule removes only the year. What is left, 'Emnet vert ikkje tilbydd .' with a stray space before the full stop, now says that the course is not offered at all, which #306 meant to prevent. In data/processed/course_plans.RDS, 24 of 1,671 HVL plans keep the leftover ('Emnet vert ikkje tilbydd studieåret .' in 14, 'Emnet vert ikkje tilbydd .' in 10). No Bokmål leftover remains, and no other variant ('tilbode', 'tilbudt') occurs.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In R/anonymize.R, the .anon_hvl() pattern `(?m)^Emnet tilbys ikke (?:studieåret )?\d{4}/\d{4}\.?[ \t]*(?:\n|$)` covers Bokmål only. The Nynorsk line passes through to .anon_generic(), whose academic-year rule (.drop_academic_year) blanks just '2025/2026'.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_hvl(), widen the alternation to `(?m)^Emnet (?:tilbys ikke|vert ikkje tilbydd|blir ikkje tilbydd) (?:studieåret )?\d{4}/\d{4}\.?[ \t]*(?:\n|$)`. Add Nynorsk cases, with and without 'studieåret', next to the Bokmål ones in tests/testthat/test-anonymize.R. Then run tar_make() and explain the 24 changed HVL plans in metrics_check; some may merge with neighbouring years that had no notice.
